acceptanceCriteria: The row states every condition under which flaky-retry is emitted, matching flakyOutcome, with an anchored citation.
body: Found by Codex review of PR #1207 (V1-1943). The flaky-retry row in docs/specs/js-live-test-provider-v0.md says the reason is set only for state flaky / PASSED, but flakyOutcome (internal/jstestprovider/projection.go:172-178) is also true for divergent attempt statuses. Pre-existing prose inaccuracy.
title: js-live-test-provider-v0 flaky-retry row understates when flaky-retry is emitted
